chain.label: Narrow mountainous valleys near Ketchikan, many too narrow for a 180-degree escape turn
chain.trigger: many valleys in the area are too narrow for an airplane to make a full 180 turn to avoid entering or to escape an inadvertent entry into IMC

chain.label: Persistent onshore southwest flow carrying Pacific moisture into the area's valleys, producing rapidly changing localized cloud cover
chain.trigger: cloudy and rainy conditions are regularly present around the Ketchikan area due to a persistent onshore wind from the southwest that carries abundant moisture from the Pacific Ocean

chain.label: FAA relied on voluntary compliance with the operators' LOA and on Part 135 VFR minimums that provide an insufficient safety margin in this environment
chain.trigger: The NTSB determined that the FAA's reliance on voluntary compliance with the LOA was a contributing factor in the August 2021 accident.

chain.label: No required cue-based weather training for Ketchikan air tour pilots; the Medallion BATD training was voluntary and no longer available after 2019
chain.trigger: the FAA cannot effectively oversee and ensure the effectiveness of cue-based training that individual operators implement... because the training is not required

caused_by.evidence: many of the resulting solutions adopted by the FAA involved voluntary operator actions that have proven ineffective or are no longer in effect

chain.label: Pilot flew a nonstandard route, off the LOA standard tour routes, into a narrow valley
chain.trigger: the accident pilot was not following the standard routes in the LOA at the time of the accident

caused_by.evidence: compliance with the LOA was not required... pilots would deviate from the operational elements in the LOA, such as by flying nonstandard routes

chain.label: Airplane entered a narrow valley and encountered deteriorating weather with increasing cloud and visibility reduced by precipitation and mist
chain.trigger: the airplane entered a narrow valley and encountered deteriorating weather. As the cloud cover increased and visibility was reduced due to precipitation and mist

caused_by.evidence: These weather patterns helped create the type of rapidly changing, localized cloud cover that the air tour involved in the August 2021 accident encountered.
the accident pilot likely flew close to the right side of the valley where the accident occurred

chain.label: Pilot decided to continue VFR flight into IMC rather than reverse course or divert
chain.trigger: the pilot's decision to continue visual flight rules (VFR) flight into instrument meteorological conditions (IMC), which resulted in controlled flight into terrain

caused_by.evidence: As the cloud cover increased and visibility was reduced due to precipitation and mist
continued need for improved pilot training on reducing the risk of weather-related accidents involving continuation of flight under VFR into IMC
area air tour pilots routinely need to decide whether the current weather conditions are good enough to safely fly VFR

chain.label: Airplane flown at progressively lower altitudes to stay below the cloud ceiling in the valley
chain.trigger: passenger photographs show that the pilot flew at lower altitudes, consistent with a passenger report... where he attempted to remain below the cloud ceiling and avoid entering instrument meteorological conditions

caused_by.evidence: he attempted to remain below the cloud ceiling and avoid entering instrument meteorological conditions (IMC)

chain.label: Airplane trapped in close proximity to cloud-obscured high terrain with no room to execute an escape turn
chain.trigger: Airplane pilots are at risk of impacting the area's high terrain if they continue into cloudy conditions that obscure mountains

caused_by.evidence: two pilots familiar with the valley where the accident occurred stated that they thought it was likely too narrow to safely execute a 180 turn in an airplane
the top of the mountainous terrain near the accident location was obscured by cloud cover

chain.label: Controlled flight into heavily wooded mountainous terrain in IMC; airplane destroyed
chain.trigger: the airplane impacted mountainous terrain in IMC

caused_by.evidence: impacted heavily wooded, mountainous terrain near Ketchikan
the pilot's decision to continue VFR flight into IMC, which resulted in controlled flight into terrain

chain.label: Pilot and five passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and five passengers were fatally injured, and the airplane was destroyed.

caused_by.evidence: impacted heavily wooded, mountainous terrain near Ketchikan. The pilot and five passengers were fatally injured
